_about: Lobby waitlist (GreMi 2026-11-11): Race Control spots chatters who want to race with GreMi (no command needed), answers them once with how to join, and lists the last `size` of them in the OBS lobby dock (/dock on the staff server). Someone already in the last `size` is not added or answered again. commands = always answered (cooldown per person). texts = the answer, picked by the Twitch stream category (the first key the category contains, else default); {name} = the chatter. interest = {topic, cue, not} regexes like twitch_timers.json ask (topic AND cue, and NOT not). The dock reads TikTok chat itself (TikFinity) with the same interest regexes and answers there through Streamer.bot (action `tiktok_action`).

texts.le mans: @{name} In LMU look for the lobby called GreMI_Gaming, the password is GreMi
texts.default: @{name} Add me as a Friend on EA: GreMi_Gaming - And ask for an invite when we are in the Lobby.
